verdict.rationale: Lithic documents agentic issuing by name, through its agentic-commerce solution page and an agentic-payments blog post. That post walks through creating a virtual card and attaching Authorization Rules for merchant categories, transaction limits and velocity. Card-level rules on MCC, country and currency, plus card spend limits, supply the scoping controls. Missing for 10: documented card expiry setting, explicit single-merchant locking (evidence shows only MCC-category rules), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent card use.
